patch.value: At least twenty exact questions on copies of verified public trackers compare recursive and truncated one-call runs with the same local model; report accuracy, tokens, calls and wall time honestly.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Live evaluation is running sequentially on verified PUBLIC copies of pm-vcs and pm-lint. Twenty-four exact ground-truth aggregations; same installed local model in both arms; 4096 context, 96 output limit. Early results are negative: the small model copies context or requests excessive reads; budget refusals count as incorrect. No success claim is inferred from the architecture.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Measured npm run test:live: 24 exact questions from verified PUBLIC tracker copies (145 and 12 items; 814268 and 54941 JSON bytes), local gemma4-local:e2b-q3km, context 4096, output 96, temperature 0. RLM: 1/24 correct (4.17%), 35557 provider tokens total (1481.54/question), 82 model requests (3.42/question), 622384 ms total (25.93 s/question), 23 budget refusals. Truncated stuffing: 0/24 correct, 25225 tokens (1051.04/question), 24 requests (1/question), 117573 ms (4.90 s/question). One root per RLM question and no child calls. This does not demonstrate an RLM advantage. Public per-question metrics and response digests are in eval-results.json; README contains the table.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Calibration diagnosis: eval overrode defaults to 4096 context, 96 output tokens and 16000 run budget. Full read/partition payloads exceeded the next prompt, while output was too small for copying useful slices into spawn JSON. Add compact deterministic partition references in the model protocol, retain the exported lossless environment API, calibrate with synthetic two-partition/two-child tests, and measure without answer-based tuning. Eval will copy only a verified public revision and explicitly pin loopback Ollama transport.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Measured run is in progress with the small installed local model. The harness now records published source revision hashes, exact truth, compact partition reachability and model request counts, JSON answer scores, and response digests only. PM_RLM_LIVE_MODEL and PM_RLM_LIVE_BASE_URL are supported; external evaluation endpoints are rejected before inference.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Calibrated live eval completed successfully: 24 questions from public revisions pm-vcs f9283201108919939d0e1cfb489358c87ea8822b (145 items, 814268 JSON bytes) and pm-lint f2c20efa78139f4071f3dd08d317bea05337fe28 (12 items, 54941 bytes). Model gemma4-local:e2b-q3km, loopback Ollama, GPU execution observed, context 32768, output 512, budget 300000, depth 2, max calls 8. RLM 7/24 correct (29.17%), 339641 provider tokens total (14151.71/question), 254 requests (10.58/question), 1622475 ms total (67.60 seconds/question). Stuffing 2/24 (8.33%), 239974 tokens (9998.92/question), 24 requests (1/question), 1001191 ms (41.72 seconds/question). Eight RLM budget refusals; zero of 24 runs reached a child; 24 ledger roots total. Twelve truths are zero, so constant zero would score 12/24. No recursive aggregation quality or RLM advantage is established. README and eval-results.json retain provenance, truth and aggregates; raw responses are replaced by digests.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Seeded v2 design audited without inference using verified public revisions of pm-vcs (145 items) and pm-lint (12 items). Exactly 24 questions, 21 distinct answers, 13 numeric and 11 id-valued answers. Numeric range 0 through 12196. Histogram: answer 4 and ids pm-lint-8kis and pm-lint-trap each occur twice; all other 18 answers occur once. Most-common constant baseline 2/24 (8.33%); zero baseline 1/24 (4.17%). Selection uses only exact tracker truth and seed pm-rlm-balanced-v2, four numeric magnitude bands, id answers, and a per-source cap of two occurrences per answer. No new model calls. Previous measured results are labeled historical in README; exact new tasks and histogram are in docs/eval-design.json. Archive extraction now verifies every path and blob byte; attribute-bearing real Git regressions cover export-ignore and export-subst.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Revert proof: removing the answer-frequency cap makes the seeded distribution regression fail. Removing archive path-count validation changes the missing-path refusal and fails its diagnosis assertion; removing byte equality permits export-subst corruption and fails the real Git regression. All sources restored byte-for-byte. No model inference was run for this design audit.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Exactly one authorized cloud invocation completed all 24 pairs with glm-5.3:cloud, 131072 shared context allocation, 512 output allocation, temperature 0, existing 300000 charged-token budget, depth 2 and eight ledger calls. Source fingerprint matched before report generation. RLM: 0/24; 3511126 recorded tokens total, 146296.92 tokens/question; 183.78 seconds/question; 19.17 model requests/question; child reach 0/24. Stuffing: 0/24; 443318 recorded tokens total, 18471.58 tokens/question; 5.37 seconds/question; 1 request/question. RLM outer refusal histogram: budget 15, model/transport 9. Stuffing model/transport refusals: 8. RLM recorded 451 invalid-action refusals and zero delivered-read charge. Mean RLM charged/used/pending tokens: 151634.96/146296.92/5338.04. Pending reservations explain the difference; recorded responses settled to actual usage. Constant baselines: most-common answer 2/24 (8.33%), zero 1/24 (4.17%). No questions, prompts or settings were tuned during the run, and no further model calls were made. docs/EVAL-CLOUD.md, README and eval-results.json record exact results and limitations. This null result does not establish recursive aggregation quality or an RLM advantage.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Implement a public typed eval SDK and native CLI over immutable certified source copies. Keep both arms on the same local Ollama model, version exact questions and gold answers, retain failed attempts in accuracy and call counts, and label token provenance. Evaluation writes only to uniquely owned disposable SDK trackers; source corpus is read-only. Historical invalidated results remain unchanged. Validate no-git operation, competing evaluations, crash boundaries, and behavioral reverts before the CI release gates.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: The typed evaluateRlm API and rlm eval command now bind frozen corpus hashes, use the same local-only model in both arms, preserve all refusals in the denominator, and emit compact summaries with opt-in rows. Evaluation controllers use the existing SDK-backed ledger lease, SDK lookup/create, and description compare-and-set transactions. No new deletion path exists. Interrupted reservations become explicit unknown metrics on rerun rather than duplicate inference; completed receipts are reused.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Public provenance verified for frozen pm-rlm and pm-lint revisions. The versioned suite has 24 format-neutral exact questions, including ownership, blockers, dependency paths and last-change timestamps. Local Ollama inventory was reachable, but Gemma generation exceeded 60 seconds and an independent minimal FunctionGemma probe exceeded 20 seconds without a response. The interrupted local trial is retained as pending evidence. The explicitly labeled constant-zero stub completed 24 paired public-data questions, 4/24 correct in both arms; these numbers validate harness mechanics, not model quality. Acceptance requiring a completed local-model comparison remains unmet, so the PR will be draft and this item remains in_progress.
